title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder - Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep the area around the toilet looking clean and uncluttered with a recessed toilet paper holder that sits neatly in the wall for a built-in finish.

  • Save space in smaller bathrooms with an in-wall recessed design that minimizes projection from the wall.
  • Coordinate a classic look with the traditional styling of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina accessories.
  • Maintain a clean, finished appearance thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Install with confidence—coordinating mounting hardware is included.
  • Finish your project consistently with multiple designer finish options available.

Specs & Details

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 x 6.125 x 4 inches
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 inches
  • Shipping weight: 2.4 lbs
  • Mounting: recessed, in-wall; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
